title: Arcane Sorcerer Ritual
description: A hooded sorcerer in a flowing green cloak stands in a mystical study, raising one hand to conjure a swirling red energy stream and a crackling blue lightning bolt. The purple-walled room features tall bookshelves lined with glowing potion bottles, an ornate stained-glass window, a large magical lantern with hanging scrolls, and mystical symbols on the wooden floor.
